content:
Headquarters: Arlington, Virginia, United States

PerformYard is a profitable, growth-stage B2B SaaS company transforming how organizations manage and measure employee performance. Our AI-enabled platform is widely adopted for its customizable performance processes, ease of use, and measurable business impact. As we scale, PerformYard has significant opportunities to accelerate growth by creating AI-native workflows, expanding into adjacent talent modules, and modernizing our user experience.

We are seeking a customer-obsessed, strategically minded Vice President of Product to translate PerformYard's AI-native vision into validated, high-impact product experiences. By delivering AI-native innovation, modernizing the user experience to accelerate adoption, and expanding monetization pathways, this leader will directly impact ARR growth and long-term market leadership.

Reporting directly to the CTO and partnering closely with the executive team, the VP of Product will build and scale a high-performing product organization, drive a culture of data-informed decision making, and ensure product investments translate into tangible business outcomes. With a mandate to accelerate innovation and unlock durable competitive advantages, this leader will be central to PerformYard’s next phase of growth.

This is a 100% Remote Position - now & forever

What You’ll Do:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Own and evolve the long-term product vision, embedding AI-native innovation into the core platform and future offerings
  • Translate company strategy into a multi-year product roadmap aligned with ARR expansion, market positioning, and enterprise value creation
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities across product, pricing, packaging, and adjacent talent modules
  • Establish durable competitive advantages and defensible differentiation within the HR tech landscape
  • Lead product discovery practices grounded in customer insight, market intelligence, and data
  • Maintain a regular cadence of direct customer engagement to ground product decisions in real user needs

Growth & Market Expansion

  • Drive product-led growth initiatives that improve adoption, expansion, retention, and customer lifetime value
  • Develop scalable monetization strategies, including AI-driven feature differentiation and packaging evolution
  • Own the end-to-end user experience vision and partner with Design to modernize the product interface, ensuring AI-native features are intuitive and adoption-ready
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to sharpen positioning, messaging, and go-to-market effectiveness
  • Evaluate build/partner/buy decisions and guide product integrations to accelerate strategic growth

Product Execution & Leadership

  • Lead roadmap execution in partnership with Engineering, ensuring high-impact delivery with measurable outcomes
  • Partner with Engineering leadership on platform modernization, scalability, and AI-first development priorities
  • Develop team members and build a strong leadership bench to sustain organizational performance
  • Lead a high-performance culture of accountability, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Maintain operational excellence and efficiency as teams scale

 

Executive & Board Partnership

  • Serve as a key member of the executive leadership team to drive growth and enterprise value
  • Present product strategy, roadmap priorities, and growth impact to the Board with clarity and confidence
  • Advise on capital allocation, market opportunities, and strategic product investments to maximize business impact
  • Quantify the business impact of product initiatives through clear, outcome-based reporting

 

Key Metrics and Success Criteria

  • Product and Customer: Adoption rates, feature utilization, customer satisfaction and retention
  • Revenue and Growth: ARR growth, upsell/cross-sell performance and churn reduction
  • Product Delivery: Roadmap predictability, AI feature adoption, and time-to-value
  • Team and Organization: Leadership development, team engagement, retention and performance

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree with a track record of leadership success in Product leadership roles within B2B SaaS companies
  • Proven experience scaling product organizations in growth-stage companies (50-250+ employees)
  • Demonstrated success partnering with executive teams to align product strategy with business objectives and customer outcomes
  • Hands-on experience building or scaling AI-native products, not just adding AI features to existing workflows, but fundamentally rethinking user experiences around AI capabilities
  • Deep expertise driving product-led growth and monetization strategy in subscription-based SaaS models
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional Board and investor communication skills
  • Data-driven mindset, comfortable with aligning product investments to ROI and value creation
  • Decisive leader who thrives in fast paced, scaling environments

In addition to your compensation plan we also have medical, dental, and vision health insurance benefits w/ HSA plan, disability insurance, 401k plan, generous PTO, paid holidays and other benefits.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/performyard-vp-of-product
